Latest news

Library opens on Sundays

The central library will open on Sundays from next month, from 10am to 4pm. The children's floor and the computers will be open, and you can borrow and return books as on any other day. The café on the ground floor will stay closed on Sundays for now.

New crossing on Station Road

Work on a new pedestrian crossing outside the primary school on Station Road starts on Monday and should take three weeks. The road stays open, with temporary traffic lights during the day. Buses will stop at the usual stops, and a crossing patrol will help children before and after school.

Swimming lessons for adults

The leisure centre has started evening swimming lessons for adults who cannot swim or want more confidence in the water. Lessons are in small groups of six, on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 7pm. The first lesson is free, and you can book a place at reception or by phone.

Green waste collections restart

Garden waste collections restart in March for households that subscribed this year. Put your brown bin out by 7am on your usual collection day. Branches must be cut to fit inside the bin with the lid closed, and soil, stones and food waste cannot go in the brown bin.

Volunteers wanted for the spring fair

The council is looking for volunteers to help at the spring fair in the park in May. Volunteers help set up stalls, give directions and collect litter, in shifts of three hours. You need to be 16 or older. Everyone who helps gets a free lunch and a fair T-shirt.
